parameters.name: BlendList
parameters.description: The element represents the location ID of the video resource, i.e., LocationId. Refer to [Adding Video Source](~~60250~~) for LocationId, which corresponds in order with the VideoLayers elements.

parameters.name: CasterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the production studio.

If you create a production studio through the [CreateCaster](~~69338#doc-api-live-CreateCaster~~ "Creates a production studio.") interface, check the value of the CasterId parameter in the response.

If you create a production studio through the ApsaraVideo Live Console, log in to the console, then check the ID of the production studio through the following path:

Production Studios > Production Studio Management

>  The CasterId is reflected in the Name column on the Production Studio Management page.

parameters.name: MixList
parameters.description:
The element represents the location ID of the audio resource, i.e., LocationId.
LocationId is referred to in [Adding Video Source](~~60250~~), and corresponds in order with the AudioLayers elements.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live add-caster-layout --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --video-layer '[{"FillMode":"fit","HeightNormalized":1.0,"PositionRefer":"topLeft","FixedDelayDuration":5000,"PositionNormalized":[0.0],"WidthNormalized":1.0}]' --audio-layer ValidChannel=all VolumeRate=1.0 FixedDelayDuration=5000 --blend-list RV01 --mix-list RV01 --caster-id LIVEPRODUCER_POST-cn-0pp1czt0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live AddCasterLayout --region cn-hangzhou --VideoLayer.1.HeightNormalized '1.0' --AudioLayer.1.ValidChannel all --VideoLayer.1.PositionRefer topLeft --VideoLayer.1.FillMode fit --MixList.1 RV01 --VideoLayer.1.PositionNormalized.1 '0.0' --AudioLayer.1.FixedDelayDuration 5000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --VideoLayer.1.WidthNormalized '1.0' --BlendList.1 RV01 --CasterId 'LIVEPRODUCER_POST-cn-0pp1czt0000' --AudioLayer.1.VolumeRate '1.0' --VideoLayer.1.FixedDelayDuration 5000
